title: render-IR
description: Origin-neutral diagram intermediate representation consumed by the plantuml-render engine. Versioned under semver alongside the engine: removing or renaming a field is a breaking change; new drawing capabilities are minor. Emitters (the bundled PlantUML frontend, argos design-render, any future producer) validate against this schema in their own CI. Links: href, title and refs are optional on nodes and edges (contract v1, additive). A root notice is optional (contract v1, additive). Activity diagrams add the node kinds action, decision, start, end and bar and the edge kind flow; swimlanes and partitions are containers with classifier swimlane / partition (contract v1, additive).

ir.description: Major version of this contract the document targets.

notice.description: A producer's message drawn inside the SVG, e.g. which diagram kind is not drawn and why (contract v1, additive).

classifier.description: Free-form theming hook (class, interface, enum, namespace, package, …). The engine maps it to CSS classes, never to hardcoded colors.

sections.description: Ordered text compartments (e.g. attributes, then methods). Lines render verbatim, monospaced.

parent.description: Id of the enclosing container node.

at.description: Sequence row this node occupies (dividers, anchored notes).

anchor.description: Lifeline id an anchored note attaches to.

span.description: Inclusive [first, last] sequence-row range a frame covers.

href.description: Link target of the element (a URL or a fragment such as #cls-Order). The engine wraps the element in <a href>.

title.description: Tooltip text; emitted as the element's <title>.

refs.description: References a host page can use for navigation and hover cards (e.g. reqs, code, tests, diagrams). Emitted as data-ref-<key> attributes; a list joins with spaces.

order.description: Sequence row of a message; required when kind is message.
